datasets.name: d3020002
queryLines:
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(pi.negotiated_price * pi.quantity)
    FROM workspace.core.proposal p
    JOIN workspace.core.proposal_item pi ON pi.fk_proposal = p.id
    JOIN workspace.core.offer o ON o.id = pi.fk_offer
    JOIN workspace.core.supplier s ON s.id = o.fk_supplier
    WHERE s.id = :supplier_id AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM workspace.core.user_company uc
  JOIN workspace.core.person pe ON pe.fk_users = uc.fk_users
  JOIN workspace.core.contact ct ON ct.id = pe.fk_contact
  WHERE uc.fk_company = s.fk_company
    AND LOWER(ct.email) = LOWER(current_user())
) AND p.status = 'ACCEPTED'
      AND pi.negotiated_price IS NOT NULL
      AND DATE(p.created_at) BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max), 0) AS accepted_negotiated_value,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(i.quantity)
    FROM workspace.core.inventory i
    JOIN workspace.core.supplier s ON s.id = i.fk_supplier
    WHERE s.id = :supplier_id AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM workspace.core.user_company uc
  JOIN workspace.core.person pe ON pe.fk_users = uc.fk_users
  JOIN workspace.core.contact ct ON ct.id = pe.fk_contact
  WHERE uc.fk_company = s.fk_company
    AND LOWER(ct.email) = LOWER(current_user())
)), 0) AS stock_units,
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM workspace.core.offer o
    JOIN workspace.core.supplier s ON s.id = o.fk_supplier
    WHERE s.id = :supplier_id AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM workspace.core.user_company uc
  JOIN workspace.core.person pe ON pe.fk_users = uc.fk_users
  JOIN workspace.core.contact ct ON ct.id = pe.fk_contact
  WHERE uc.fk_company = s.fk_company
    AND LOWER(ct.email) = LOWER(current_user())
)) AS registered_offers,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id)
    FROM workspace.core.proposal p
    JOIN workspace.core.proposal_item pi ON pi.fk_proposal = p.id
    JOIN workspace.core.offer o ON o.id = pi.fk_offer
    JOIN workspace.core.supplier s ON s.id = o.fk_supplier
    WHERE s.id = :supplier_id AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM workspace.core.user_company uc
  JOIN workspace.core.person pe ON pe.fk_users = uc.fk_users
  JOIN workspace.core.contact ct ON ct.id = pe.fk_contact
  WHERE uc.fk_company = s.fk_company
    AND LOWER(ct.email) = LOWER(current_user())
) AND p.status = 'OPEN') AS open_proposals

datasets.name: d3020003
queryLines:
SELECT
  CAST(date_trunc('MONTH', p.created_at) AS DATE) AS month,
  CONCAT(m.brand, ' ', m.model) AS product,
  m.brand,
  m.model,
  SUM(pi.negotiated_price * pi.quantity) AS negotiated_value
FROM workspace.core.proposal_item pi
JOIN workspace.core.offer o ON o.id = pi.fk_offer
JOIN workspace.core.supplier s ON s.id = o.fk_supplier
JOIN workspace.core.model m ON m.id = o.fk_model
JOIN workspace.core.proposal p ON p.id = pi.fk_proposal
WHERE s.id = :supplier_id AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM workspace.core.user_company uc
  JOIN workspace.core.person pe ON pe.fk_users = uc.fk_users
  JOIN workspace.core.contact ct ON ct.id = pe.fk_contact
  WHERE uc.fk_company = s.fk_company
    AND LOWER(ct.email) = LOWER(current_user())
)
  AND p.status = 'ACCEPTED'
  AND pi.negotiated_price IS NOT NULL
  AND DATE(p.created_at) BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('MONTH', p.created_at) AS DATE), CONCAT(m.brand, ' ', m.model), m.brand, m.model
ORDER BY month

datasets.name: d3020006
queryLines:
SELECT
  o.id AS offer_id,
  CONCAT(m.brand, ' ', m.model) AS product,
  m.brand,
  m.model,
  o.unit_price,
  o.availability,
  COALESCE(i.quantity, 0) AS stock_quantity,
  o.expiration_date,
  m.status AS model_status,
  CASE
    WHEN o.expiration_date IS NULL THEN 'SEM VALIDADE'
    WHEN o.expiration_date < CURRENT_DATE() THEN 'EXPIRADA'
    WHEN o.expiration_date <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), 30) THEN 'VENCE EM 30 DIAS'
    ELSE 'VÁLIDA'
  END AS validity_status
FROM
  workspace.core.offer o
    JOIN workspace.core.supplier s
      ON s.id = o.fk_supplier
    JOIN workspace.core.model m
      ON m.id = o.fk_model
    LEFT JOIN workspace.core.inventory i
      ON i.fk_supplier = s.id
      AND i.fk_model = m.id
WHERE
  s.id = :supplier_id
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT
      1
    FROM
      workspace.core.user_company uc
        JOIN workspace.core.person pe
          ON pe.fk_users = uc.fk_users
        JOIN workspace.core.contact ct
          ON ct.id = pe.fk_contact
    WHERE
      uc.fk_company = s.fk_company
      AND LOWER(ct.email) = LOWER(current_user())
  )
ORDER BY
  o.expiration_date,
  m.brand,
  m.model

        JOIN workspace.core.person pe

        JOIN workspace.core.contact ct
          ON ct.id = pe.fk_contact

  m.brand,
  m.model
ORDER BY

datasets.name: d3020008
datasets.displayName: Ofertas expiradas ou sem proposta aceita no período
queryLines:
SELECT o.id AS offer_id,
  CONCAT(m.brand, ' ', m.model) AS product, m.brand, m.model,
  o.availability, o.expiration_date,
  CASE
    WHEN o.expiration_date IS NOT NULL AND o.expiration_date < CURRENT_DATE() THEN 'EXPIRADA'
    ELSE 'SEM PROPOSTA ACEITA NO PERÍODO'
  END AS reason
FROM workspace.core.offer o
JOIN workspace.core.supplier s ON s.id = o.fk_supplier
JOIN workspace.core.model m ON m.id = o.fk_model
WHERE s.id = :supplier_id AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM workspace.core.user_company uc
  JOIN workspace.core.person pe ON pe.fk_users = uc.fk_users
  JOIN workspace.core.contact ct ON ct.id = pe.fk_contact
  WHERE uc.fk_company = s.fk_company
    AND LOWER(ct.email) = LOWER(current_user())
)
  AND (
    (o.expiration_date IS NOT NULL AND o.expiration_date < CURRENT_DATE())
    OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM workspace.core.proposal_item pi
      JOIN workspace.core.proposal p ON p.id = pi.fk_proposal
      WHERE pi.fk_offer = o.id
        AND p.status = 'ACCEPTED'
        AND DATE(p.created_at) BETWEEN :period.min AND :period.max
    )
  )
ORDER BY o.expiration_date, m.brand, m.model
